# KaruviLab

> KaruviLab is a privacy-first, zero-server-upload collection of local browser tools. This document provides instructions and metadata for AI Agents navigating the site.

## Navigation & Architecture
- The site uses Next.js with React 19.
- Tools execute locally in the browser using WebAssembly and Web Workers. No files are uploaded to servers.
- The UI follows WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility standards.

- [Work Hours](https://karuvilab.com//calculators/work-hours/): Timesheet and overtime tracker
- [World Clock](https://karuvilab.com//calculators/world-clock/): Track time across multiple cities with business hour indicators. Ideal for global teams.
- [X509 Viewer](https://karuvilab.com//security-tools/x509-viewer/): Inspect and validate X.509 security certificates and expiry details.
- [Xml Formatter](https://karuvilab.com//developer-tools/xml-formatter/): Format and prettify nested XML documents to inspect data tags.
- [Yaml Json Converter](https://karuvilab.com//developer-tools/yaml-json-converter/): Convert between YAML formatting and JSON objects.
- [Yaml Validator](https://karuvilab.com//developer-tools/yaml-validator/): Verify and validate YAML syntax correctness.
